summary.name: Spyder
summary.one_liner: Spyder is a Python IDE built for scientists and data analysts, combining Jupyter-style interactive programming with development tools for writing reusable code.
use_cases: turning scripts into reusable modules and packages
plotting and data work with Matplotlib and Pandas
installing a ready-to-use Python scientific environment
summary.what_it_does: Spyder is positioned as a Python IDE for data analysts, scientists and engineers, aiming to offer the ease of Jupyter together with some advanced features found in PyCharm and VSCode. It is built around interactive programming with quick feedback and short iteration cycles. It includes out-of-the-box integration with Matplotlib, Pandas and other PyData libraries. The page says it helps users move from single scripts to structured, reusable modules and packages while keeping interactivity, and it includes software development tools. Standalone installers are offered for installation and updates.
notable: Interactive, Jupyter-like workflow built into an IDE
Out-of-the-box integration with Matplotlib and Pandas
Standalone installers for easy install and update
Community-designed, aimed at scientific and reusable research code
caveats: Page does not state pricing or license terms
Platforms supported are not named on this page
